steps.content:
06:23, February 3, N.F. 114.
Keylan Square Black Ring Ruins,
FAC Monitoring Station Break Room.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: Has the Sun Crow Apostle not shown up yet? When will this operation finally end...

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: All this superstitious stuff Chief and that little trickster are fussing over, do you buy it?

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier B
steps.content: Well, actually, I don't dislike her. I used to think Easterners were pretty strange, always looking like they were up to something. But it seems like that girl is really trying hard to help.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: Whoa, so their trick actually works on you? Maybe that's why they sent that girl, so we'd lower our guard. I say we can't trust the Outlanders before they explain the purpose of their sorcery.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: Okay, I'll admit I don't hate her either... Even Chief is nice to her, isn't he? That's the clever hero who beat the Black Ring we're talking about. He can't be wrong.
steps.female_content: Okay, I'll admit I don't hate her either... Even Chief is nice to her, isn't she? That's the clever hero who beat the Black Ring we're talking about. She can't be wrong.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier B
steps.content: Those two are exhausted from their work today. Let them sleep for a bit. We've got it covered here.
BR-004 Ruins Outpost Break Room.
Before the fever breaks, you're having a strange dream again.
<color=#dg1f1f>Danger...</color>
It's that voice again.
An ominous heat gradually envelops your body. You recoil instinctively, but she grabs you firmly.
<color=#dg1f1f>Wake up...</color>
<color=#dg1f1f>...The Sun Crow is coming!</color>
You gradually begin to understand the words spoken by that blurry hoarse voice. Or perhaps, you're starting to grasp the genuine emotions in the anxious cries.

options: Who are you? The Sun Crow? Or...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What exactly do you mean by danger?
<size=45><color=#dg1f1f>That child... Danger... Save her!</color></size>
A blast of blazing flames hits you, knocking you out of consciousness.
Snapping your eyes open, you don't see Yanyan. However, the air around you is abnormally dry and hot. It's Mania.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is bad...
You burst out of the break room. Yanyan hasn't gone far, but... something seems wrong with her.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I don't know, I'm so scared... I've been trying so hard...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: If it fails, it's all Yanyan's fault... I don't know what to do...
The girl mumbles to herself, walking forward obliviously in the open space scorching like the inside of an oven.
Hearing your call, Yanyan, now a few meters away, does not turn back and even keeps going further.
You try to go up to her, but the closer you get, the more uneasy you feel. The grass where Yanyan passes dries up and catches fire, the air twisting with steam.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yanyan, can you hear me?
She trembles, clearly hearing something, but doesn't turn to look at you. Mania is spilling out of her, and the girl casts her gaze into nothingness.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...Great Seer, is that you? Have you finally come to find me?

Yanyan fumbles forward, as blinding golden light continuously strips away her consciousness, taking over her body. She is channeling now, but the Mania entwined around her comes from something you're more familiar with... It's the Sun Crow!

options: Wake up! The Great Seer isn't here!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Whatever it is that's luring you, you must not fall for its trap!
You reach out to touch Yanyan, but immediately recoil at the shocking heat of her body. Indeed, it's as hot as the Apostle in your memory.
Already worn out by the bow-making preparation, Yanyan grows paler, but she's still conversing with the voice in her spiritual world.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Great Seer, I've missed you, and I've got so many questions for you. I... there's too much I still need to do, but I don't know how.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yanyan, stop!
She can't hear your voice anymore.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I only need to offer my power to the Sun Crow? I see... I'm coming, I'll listen to you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't go! It's a trap!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: The Great Seer is always right...

The mark signaling the channeling begins to flicker, and Yanyan's strength is being rapidly drained. But hindered by the melting heat, you cannot get closer. The voice in your dream warns you once again.
<color=#dg1f1f>Stop it! Danger!</color>
The wake-up call seems to push you forward, helping you tear through the barrier of heat and grab hold of Yanyan.
